title: Bihar Police BPSSC ASI (Technical) Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: 22 posts of ASI (Technical) in Bihar Police Radio (Wireless). Exam postponed – see latest notice.
qualification: As per BPSSC ASI Technical Advt 07/2026 (technical/diploma criteria as notified)
ageLimit: As per Bihar Police / BPSSC rules for ASI Technical
selectionProcess: Preliminary Written Exam (postponed) → Further stages as per commission
documentsRequired: Registration ID and DOB; printed e-admit card; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in
2. Read Exam Postponement notice for Advt 07/2026
3. Login at apply-bpssc.com if admit card was already issued
4. Wait for new exam date and revised hall ticket
5. Do not report on the old 05 August 2026 date
shortDescription: BPSSC ASI (Technical) Admit Card was out on 24 July; Prelims of 05 August 2026 is POSTPONED. New date soon at bpssc.bihar.gov.in (Advt 07/2026).
content:
Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) had released e-Admit Cards for ASI (Technical) under Advt. No. 07/2026 from 24 July 2026.

Update: The Preliminary exam scheduled for 05 August 2026 has been postponed. A new date will be announced on the official website.

  • Posts: ASI Technical in Bihar Police Radio (Wireless)
  • Vacancies: 22
  • Apply period: 21 May – 21 June 2026
  • Status: Exam postponed – do not appear on the old date
